subject: Draft MAP & target signature window for Bluefin Analytics
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@bluefin.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & target signature window for Bluefin Analytics

Hi Oliver — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap + the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) attached (Bluefin_MAP_v1.xlsx). I pulled together milestones we discussed and an initial owner list so we can validate responsibilities and lock a target signature window with procurement.

Key points from our call:
- Goal: prod-ready inference pipeline for Bluefin insights team by H1 Nov pilot (non-prod sandbox first).
- Primary success criteria: integration test harness passing, latency targets met (p99 < 240ms), and data residency controls for EU-sourced data (if needed later).
- Procurement preference: single-signature SOW + standard commercial terms; your procurement team asked for a 2-week review window.

Initial MAP milestones (dates are placeholders until you confirm):
1) SOW review & commercial redlines — Owner: Bluefin Legal / Redwood Sales (Target: 2027-09-28)
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence exchange — Owner: Bluefin Sec / Redwood Sec (Target: 2027-09-23)
3) Tech handoff & integration plan — Owner: Bluefin Eng / Redwood Solutions (Target: 2027-10-04)
4) Pilot environment & validation — Owner: Bluefin Eng / Redwood Eng (Target: 2027-10-18)
5) Contract signature (target window) — Owner: Bluefin Procurement / Redwood Legal (Target: 2027-10-04 to 2027-10-06)

Requested actions from you this week:
- Confirm procurement signature deadline window (is the 10/4–10/6 window feasible?)
- Share any internal approvers we should loop (legal, procurement contact, budget owner)
- Confirm if the SOC2 / evidence pack needs to be routed to a third-party portal or sent directly to procurement.

Attachments: Bluefin_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft), SOW-draft-Bluefin.pdf (initial commercial template).

If that timeline looks tight, we can prioritize the SOW + procurement path to meet your internal freeze dates — let me know. Happy to adjust owners/dates and produce a consolidated MAP v1.1.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0138

From: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@bluefin.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Silva <marta@legal.bluefin.io>, procurement@bluefin.io
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & target signature window for Bluefin Analytics

Jasmine — appreciate the quick follow-up and the MAP. High-level: procurement just notified me of a planned vendor freeze the week of Oct 11. We need the SOW fully signed before that freeze takes effect. The team would prefer an earlier signature (ideally the first full week of October).

Couple notes / asks:
- Can you compress the SOW review timeline? Our legal can do a quick turn but needs final commercial terms + redlines by end of next week (9/24) to hit an early Oct signature.
- Procurement would like explicit milestone dates for the integration runbook (they need to map vendor onboarding into their vendor intake).
- Marta (cc'd) will handle legal redlines; procurement is copied for calendar coordination.

Also: is the SOC2 package you referenced available today? If you can provide an evidence bundle or a link, that speeds procurement sign-off.

Oliver
Head of Data Platforms
Bluefin Analytics
oliver.reed@bluefin.io
+1 (617) 555-0219

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@bluefin.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marta Silva <marta@legal.bluefin.io>, procurement@bluefin.io
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & target signature window for Bluefin Analytics

Thanks Oliver — understood on the freeze. We can tighten the MAP and prioritize the review path to target an early-Oct signature. I pushed an updated MAP (Bluefin_MAP_v1.1.xlsx) with compressed review milestones and explicit owners; link below for collaborative edits.

Key changes in v1.1:
- SOW review & redline deadline moved to 2027-09-24 (Owner: Bluefin Legal / Redwood Sales)
- Security evidence bundle delivery: 2027-09-16 (Redwood Sec) — see SOC2 link below.
- Integration runbook draft due 2027-09-29 (Owner: Redwood Solutions) to give your eng team a week to validate prior to pilot prep.
- Contract signature target: 2027-10-03 to 2027-10-05 (we shifted a day earlier to align to your freeze).

Proposed next steps (this week):
1) Marta — can you confirm if a single-signature SOW is acceptable or if Bluefin needs an amended vendor addendum? If single-signature is fine, we'll route the Redwood standard SOW for one redline pass.
2) Procurement — share the calendar blackout dates and the exact person who will execute the SOW so we can include them on the DocuSign routing.
3) Bluefin Eng — if you can assign a primary integration owner, we will create a short tech onboarding checklist to minimize rework during pilot.

Links / attachments:
- Updated MAP (collaborative): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bBluefinMAP
- SOC2 evidence (read-only): https://redwood.ai/reports/SOC2-2027
- Draft SOW (attached): SOW-draft-Bluefin.pdf
- DocuSign placeholder (we will pre-populate once legal confirms recipient): https://docusign.com/placeholder/BF-2027-014

If everyone can confirm the 9/24 redline deadline and the 10/03–10/05 signature window by EOD Friday, we will lock the MAP and begin legal routing.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@bluefin.io>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marta Silva <marta@legal.bluefin.io>, procurement@bluefin.io
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & target signature window for Bluefin Analytics

Oliver / Marta / team — I can confirm Redwood can support an accelerated legal path to meet an early Oct signature. A few operational asks so we don't create rework:

- Please confirm primary signer name/email for DocuSign. We will pre-populate the SOW and route for a single signature if that's acceptable.
- For procurement: we will provide a SOC2 evidence bundle and a short access window (link provided in the MAP). If procurement requires portal upload, send the portal details and we will upload by 9/16.
- Laura (cc) will lead the commercial exceptions review; Laura, please flag anything that needs exec approval.

I will add a legal review milestone (internal Redwood) and a checklist for the integration handoff. Once Marta confirms redline priorities, we will produce SOW v1.1 and route it for redline by 9/22 to hit the 9/24 internal deadline.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (212) 555-0099
